notes: u64 addition wraps modulo 2^64: V compiles to C, where unsigned overflow is well defined.
strings.Builder.write_u_decimal formats each number straight into the buffer, without allocating.
V switches C's stdout to unbuffered at startup, so output collects in a 64 KiB strings.Builder written to os.stdout() per chunk.
